Laura / team — thanks for patience. Per review with our broker and underwriting, Redwood can commit to the following acceptance criteria for the Order Form: 

Acceptance checklist (to be inserted into Order Form) — all items below are acceptable proof of compliance:
1) Certificate of Insurance (COI) that lists policy limits equal to or greater than HelixCloud’s stated minimums (CGL $5M aggregate / $1M per occurrence is acceptable only if paired with Umbrella to reach $5M—please confirm HelixCloud allows umbrella stacking).
2) Additional Insured endorsement naming "HelixCloud LLC and its affiliates" — endorsement form or carrier-issued endorsement is acceptable. If the carrier cannot issue the endorsement prior to signature, a broker confirmation letter stating endorsement will be provided within X business days (we propose 10 business days) and the Order Form will contain a remediation path if not received.
3) Evidence of Cyber/Privacy coverage at HelixCloud’s minimums (policy declaration page or COI remarks).
4) Broker confirmation letter if any endorsements are pending at signing.

Please note: Redwood cannot unilaterally change carrier forms. If HelixCloud requires a specific endorsement form number (carrier-specific), we’ll need to confirm with the carrier; lead time may increase.
